_comment: WASH attack configuration. Set each model_path to a local HF model directory or hub id. 'anchor_model'/'anchor_watermarks' name the watermarked model whose signal the WASH blend removes; the other models dilute it. Set 'is_instruct': true on a model to apply its chat template (base models use false). Add or remove models freely (1+ models). Watermark params below are the published defaults.
